newsitem.title: GERMANY: World oilseeds area seen rising in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: World oilseeds area seen rising in 97/98.

text.p: Global oilseeds plantings in 1997/98 should increase by 4.3 percent over 1996/97 to just under 193 million hectares, the Oil World newsletter said.
The independent publication said its estimate was preliminary and based on anticipated demand and current prices.
Most of the increase would be seen in Chinese, Brazilian and U.S. soybeans, European and Canadian rapeseed and, to a lesser extent, in Argentine sunseed.

Assuming normal weather and average yield rises of 1.4 percent to 1.41 tonnes per hectare, Oil World estimated output of 10 key oilseeds at 272.6 million tonnes in 1997/98, following an estimated 257.2 million in 1996/97.
It tentatively pegged 1997/98 consumption at 269.5 million tonnes compared with 262.0 million in 1996/97.
